name: matmul_nbits_4bit_accuracy_level
note: accuracy_level 4 asks a runtime to quantize the ACTIVATIONS to 8-bit integers as well, and onnxruntime takes the option while this engine keeps them in floats. The two therefore differ by far more than any other case here - the measured figure is about three thousandths - and the bar is the plan's own tolerance for a quantized graph. This case exists to PIN that difference rather than to hide it.
